events.title: October 12 patch notes
events.summary: Patch Notes Map Editor OverhaulThe map editor has been rebuilt from the ground up. A new layoutA tidier screen with much more room for your map: one row of buttons along the top, your tools down the left, and map settings down the right.See your map exactly as it will look in battle, or press V for the blueprint view. DrawingPaint Road, Ground (where you can place guns), Water or Gates with keys 1–4.New ways to draw: square brush, round brush, line, rectangle, ellipse, fill, and a path pen for d

events.title: Rolling bug fixes being deployed
events.summary: Hey everyone. Over the next 12 hours there will be many small, targeted updates aimed at addressing the various issues that have been identified and reported, examples including crashing, freezing, unintuitive UI experiences, and so on. These patches will be small (around 10mb each). I invite you to share you experiences in this thread or on Discord. Be brutally honest and clear. I want to make a great game, so your feedback is essential. The demo is the perfect cornerstone for yourselves and us
